quote: The conjecture was made by Emil Artin to Helmut Hasse on September 27, 1927, according to the latter's diary.
note: Artin verbally communicated the conjecture to Helmut Hasse on September 13, 1927; Hasse formally recorded it in his mathematical diary on September 27, 1927. The date 1927 marks the first posed date based on Hasse's diary entry.
